rules: All money is integer cents. Months are 1-based from start_month.
Monthly rate is annual_rate_bps / 120000. Round monthly interest to nearest cent, ties up.
Scheduled payment is the exact amortizing payment rounded UP to a whole cent; zero-rate payment is ceil(principal/term).

Each month: accrue interest, pay min(scheduled_payment, balance plus interest), then apply the extra principal capped at remaining balance. In the final contractual month, the regular payment instead settles the entire balance plus interest, including any cent-rounding residue.
No fees, escrow, penalties, or refinancing. Stop at payoff. Ignore extra payments dated after payoff.
Compare against the same loan without any extra payments. Report both schedules, payoff months, interest totals and their difference.
